input.title: 2016 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 17T
input.descriptionHtml:
Pre-owned 2016 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 17T in Dune. The 17\' tandem flagship with twin MirageDrive GTs and Turbo Fins, H-Bar, four paddles, dual carts, and Triton LT trailer. $6,499.

2016 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 17T Tandem Flagship, Fully Rigged, Dune

 

The Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 17T is the largest kayak Hobie has ever built a 17' tandem platform with twin MirageDrive slots, full H-Rail tracks down both sides, and a stable, walkable deck. Built for two anglers working the same water, or one angler who wants the room and stability of a small skiff with the silent propulsion of a Mirage Drive.

This 2016 example is in Dune and comes set up to fish out of the box. Both drives are MirageDrive GTs fitted with Turbo Fins the high-thrust standard for this vintage and the kayak ships on its Triton LT trailer with a spare, so it's a trailered package ready to launch. Located at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, Illinois.

Included with this kayak:

  • Two MirageDrive GTs with Turbo Fins
  • Two Hobie Vantage seats (standard)
  • Hobie H-Bar standing assist
  • H-Rail Rod Holder
  • Two H-Rail mounting plates
  • Anchor Trolley system
  • Railblaza 3 lb flag and light combo
  • Two Hobie 260cm paddles (standard)
  • Two adjustable T-handle paddles
  • Hobie Heavy Duty Plug-in Cart (foam-filled no-flat wheels)
  • Hobie Trax 2-30 Plug-in Cart (beach wheels)
  • Triton LT trailer with spare tire
 
Length 17' / 5.18 m
Width 38" / 0.97 m
Capacity 600 lbs / 272 kg
Fitted Hull Weight 146.5 lbs / 66 kg
Fully Rigged Weight 189.5 lbs / 86 kg
Hull Rotomolded Polyethylene
Condition Pre-owned
Color Dune
Drive Two MirageDrive GTs with Turbo Fins
Trailer Triton LT with spare
Price $6,499


See it in person. This PA17T is at our showroom in Ottawa, IL. Call 815.433.2200 to confirm availability or stop in at 1851 Old Chicago Road
